title: Memory keeps billing while a Fluid function waits on I/O
detail: Active CPU billing pauses when a request is blocked on I/O, but provisioned memory billing continues for the full wall-clock duration of the invocation.
impact: The headline saving is real but it is CPU-only. An agent that sits for 40 seconds waiting on a model still pays memory for all 40 seconds. Model the memory line separately before assuming the 90 percent figure applies to your bill.
